Treatment summary
Patient presented following a collision sustained while turning left, with a reported
impact to the vehicle that is consistent in type and force with the neck and back
strain described. Diagnosis is cervical and lumbar strain. Cervical and lumbar imaging
and the standard neurological and orthopedic examinations were within normal limits.
Nearly all reported findings rest on the patient's own descriptions of pain and
limited motion. No prior injury or treatment to the same areas is known from history or
records. Care has been intensive, totaling 43 visits, most occurring near-daily, and
pain complaints were extended to additional body regions several weeks after the
collision. Billing records do not show repeated charges for the same services. Given
the mechanism and the normal objective testing, continued care should be reviewed
against accepted treatment guidelines for soft tissue injury, with attention to the
frequency of visits and the basis for the newer complaints.
